chapter: Streetcar, Cab revival shows and trips abroad
title: Wingy Manone's artificial arm and the sailors
summary: In 1946 at Cafe Society a sailor fight ended with Wingy Manone's arm coming off and Wingy beating the man with it.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: That was a funny job, you know, because I tell you the time -- you know, Wingy had one arm, you know, and one night some sailors came in, and they wanted Wingy to play a tune, you know. So I mean he said, okay, and so the guys went away and he didn't play the tune.

So they came back. They kept going back and forth until they get into a big fight. And, you know, Wingy, Wingy jumped off the bandstand, and this guy reached and grabbed Wingy and grabbed Wingy by this arm and it came off.

And the sailor, he didn't know that Wingy -- and he is standing there, standing with Wingy's arm in his hand, and Wingy reached and grabbed with his other hand, the arm, and started beating the guy across the head.
: He was a character, wasn't he?
Yeah, Wingy was something. He used to call me the Mongolian because I have high cheekbones and stuff like that.
